title: Politics, Policies and Planning for Climate Action
description: British Columbia is used as a case study to introduce the policy and political contexts that shape climate action across scales from local to global, including relevant institutional and governance innovations. Emphasis placed on skills and strategies for engaging and overcoming stagnation and polarization; developing strategies that are responsive to climate science as well as social and ecological impacts and effective communication.
recommendations: TCA 210 recommended prior to or in conjunction with TCA 320.
